resources.string: Buddy helps you navigate your phone by seeing what is on screen and guiding you step by step. It can highlight where to tap and help with settings and everyday tasks.
It lives quietly with you and points to the next tap — so the confusing parts of your phone finally feel simple.
Go ahead and leave this app. I’ll stay on your screen so you can follow along wherever you are.
I’m on your screen. Open anything — I’ll stay.
On the next screen, allow Buddy to appear on top — then come back here.
On the next screen, turn on Buddy Assistant — then come back here.
The cursor is on your screen.
